text:
Sam (AcmeCorp): Hey team — preparing for the POC next week. Need confirmation on SSO/SAML support, SCIM provisioning behavior, RBAC role scoping, and domain ownership controls. Also need a ballpark for Dedicated POC pricing and any compliance constraints (data residency, encryption at rest).

Alex (AE): Thanks Sam. We can do all that. Quick Q: is the POC required in a specific region (EU vs US) and do you need customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS)?

Sam (AcmeCorp): EU region preferred, and security wants KMS/HSM for keys. They also asked for the standard security questionnaire — we attached one in the earlier thread but can repost.

Priya (SE): @Sam we support SAML IdP integrations (IdP-initiated and SP-initiated), metadata upload, and automatic ACS/EntityID mapping. For SCIM we do user and group provisioning with attribute mapping and delta syncs. Note SCIM rate limits depend on plan; for Dedicated POC we can raise the throttle during the window.

Priya (SE): Example SCIM attribute mapping we typically recommend:
```
{
  "externalId": "id",
  "userName": "email",
  "name": { "givenName": "first_name", "familyName": "last_name" },
  "emails": ["email"]
}
```
This mapping is editable in the Console during the POC.

Tom (Security): On encryption: all hosted data at rest is encrypted by default. For Private/Dedicated with customer-managed keys we integrate with AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and Azure Key Vault. Audit logs (admin + auth events) are available for the POC and we can provide retention options. We can also produce a runbook for incident response.

Olga (Solutions Eng): Pricing — for a timeboxed Dedicated POC (2 weeks, single GPU pool, EU region) we usually quote a short-term reservation. Rough estimate: a 2-week reserved pool + onboarding is ~USD 12k-18k depending on GPU type and burst capacity. If you want us to include extended KV caching/latency SLOs that shifts the number slightly. I can send a formal quote after we lock the scope.

Alex (AE): Action items: 1) Sam to share IdP metadata and the security questionnaire PDF. 2) Sam to confirm region and whether KMS is required. 3) Redwood to draft scoping doc and formal POC quote.

Sam (AcmeCorp): Will share metadata and questionnaire by EOD. Also confirm they want RBAC that mirrors our internal roles (Admin / Dev / Read-only) and domain proofing to block other tenants registering their domain.

Priya (SE): RBAC: we support tenant-scoped roles and can map SAML groups to Redwood roles. Domain controls: we validate domain ownership via DNS TXT or email verification and support restricting tenant creation to verified domains.

redwood-bot: Security questionnaire uploaded: https://redwood.example.com/secure/questionnaires/acmecorp-poc.pdf (permissions: acme_poc-team).

Tom (Security): I'll review the questionnaire and call out any gaps. If you need SOC2 or ISO docs, we can provide our attestation package under NDA.

Alex (AE): Schedule: recommend a 30–45m kickoff with Sam + IdP admin + security on Mon. I'll send a calendar invite. :calendar: 

Sam (AcmeCorp): Sounds good — thanks all.

Olga (Solutions Eng): Final note: if you expect high SCIM churn (many user changes), tell us up front so we can allocate a higher SCIM throughput during the POC. Otherwise default rate limits apply. :thumbsup:

Sam (AcmeCorp): Got it — will include churn estimate in the metadata email.
